note: Returns are measured against an equal-weighted index of the stock's own sector in its market, from the first close after the event, only while the stock was in its index.

types.about: two or more directors or officers buy shares in the open market within 30 days
types.name: Several insiders buying

types.about: a director or officer buys $250,000 or more in the open market
types.name: Large insider purchase

types.about: three or more directors or officers sell within 30 days
types.name: Several insiders selling

types.about: quarterly earnings well above the same quarter a year earlier (standardised surprise of 2 or more)
types.name: Strong earnings surprise

types.about: quarterly earnings well below the same quarter a year earlier (standardised surprise of -2 or less)
types.name: Weak earnings surprise

types.about: the 50-day average crosses above the 200-day average
types.name: Golden cross

types.about: the 50-day average crosses below the 200-day average
types.name: Death cross

types.about: the first close at a 52-week high in three months
types.name: New 52-week high

types.about: news about results with clearly positive tone
types.name: Upbeat results coverage

types.about: news about results with clearly negative tone
types.name: Downbeat results coverage

types.about: news about guidance or outlook with positive tone
types.name: Positive guidance news

types.about: news about guidance or outlook with negative tone (profit warnings)
types.name: Negative guidance news

types.about: news about mergers, acquisitions or bids
types.name: Takeover or deal news

types.about: news about lawsuits, investigations or regulators
types.name: Legal or regulatory news
